jtbd.jtbd_title: Offline micro‑support for W036–W040 window (templates & nudges)
jtbd.jtbd_desc: Short templates, micro‑nudges, and quick reframes that led to meetings booked and artifacts shipped.

interactions.user_ask: Can you draft a friendly check‑in for my teacher?
interactions.jenny_reply: Here’s a 2‑line text: (1) quick progress note, (2) an offer to help with a task this week.

interactions.user_ask: I’m nervous about asking for feedback on my scene bank.
interactions.jenny_reply: Ask for 1 scene only; control scope so you can act in 24h. Here’s a one‑liner request.

interactions.user_ask: What’s a quick Reagan artifact I can ship?
interactions.jenny_reply: Record a 60‑second voiceover of your impact, overlay screenshots; done is better than perfect.

outcomes.name: teacher_checkin_sent
outcomes.details: Two check‑ins sent; one reply received.
